import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
out=[]
def fit(f,p0s,name):
    best=None
    for p0 in p0s:
        try:
            with np.errstate(all='ignore'):
                r=least_squares(lambda p: np.nan_to_num(f(eps,T,p)-sigma,nan=1e3,posinf=1e3,neginf=-1e3), p0, max_nfev=3000)
            if best is None or r.cost<best.cost: best=r
        except Exception as e:
            pass
    nmse=np.mean((f(eps,T,best.x)-sigma)**2)/np.var(sigma)
    out.append(f"{name} nmse {nmse:.3e} {np.round(best.x,4)}")
rng=np.random.default_rng(0)
fB=lambda e,t,p: p[0]+p[1]*np.exp(-p[2]*e)*t**p[3]+p[4]*e**p[5]+p[6]*t
fit(fB,[rng.normal(size=7) for _ in range(40)],"B")
fC=lambda e,t,p: p[0]+p[1]*t+p[2]*np.exp(-p[3]*e)*np.exp(-p[4]/t)+p[5]*e**p[6]*t**p[7]
fit(fC,[rng.normal(size=8) for _ in range(40)],"C")
print("\n".join(out))
